name: MonarchSegmentedControl
title: SegmentedControl
wrapsNative: Button per segment, ViewThatFits, ScrollView, matchedGeometryEffect
summary: A muted track with one raised segment, as the web segmented control. Segments can have an icon, a count or a long label, and the track scrolls when they do not fit.
whenToUse: To switch a view or a filter when a segment needs an icon, a count or more than a few words, or when there are more segments than fit.
whenNotToUse: For two to four plain-text choices the system Picker with pickerStyle(.segmented) is the platform control and stays the right answer.
api: MonarchSegmentedControl.init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<Value>, items: [MonarchSegmentedItem<Value>], size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, fillsWidth: Bool = true)
MonarchSegmentedItem.init(_ title: String, value: Value, systemImage: String? = nil, count: String? = nil, isIconOnly: Bool = false, isDisabled: Bool = false)

options.name: label
options.description: The spoken name of the control. It is not shown.

options.name: selection
options.description: The value of the selected segment.

options.name: fillsWidth
options.description: Whether the segments share the whole width.

states.name: selected
states.description: A raised surface with a hairline border and the default text colour.

states.name: unselected
states.description: The muted text colour on the track.

states.name: disabled segment
states.description: The disabled text colour; it cannot be chosen.

appearance: A track in the muted background role with 8 point corners and 2 point padding; the selected segment is a 6 point raised surface with a hairline and a small shadow. Labels are 14 points medium (12 for the small size).
platformNotes: The system segmented Picker stays the answer for two to four plain-text choices. This control exists for icons, counts, long labels and overflow, and so the same control looks the same on every OS version. The track is 44 points high at the largest size step the touch target needs: each segment has a 44 point hit area.
accessibility: The control is a container named by the label; each segment is a button with the selected trait, named by its title and count.
The selection is marked by a raised surface as well as by colour.
Each segment has a hit area of at least 44 by 44 points; text scales with Dynamic Type.
An icon-only segment is still named by its title.
edgeCases: A selection that matches no segment shows none raised.
Values must be unique; they identify the segments.
An empty count shows no count.

examples.title: View switch
examples.template:
MonarchSegmentedControl(
    {{label}},
    selection: $layout,
    items: [
        MonarchSegmentedItem({{options.0.label}}, value: {{options.0.value}}, systemImage: "list.bullet"),
        MonarchSegmentedItem({{options.1.label}}, value: {{options.1.value}}, systemImage: "rectangle.split.2x1"),
        MonarchSegmentedItem({{options.2.label}}, value: {{options.2.value}}, systemImage: "square.grid.2x2"),
    ],
    fillsWidth: false
)
examples.code:
MonarchSegmentedControl(
    "View",
    selection: $layout,
    items: [
        MonarchSegmentedItem("List", value: "list", systemImage: "list.bullet"),
        MonarchSegmentedItem("Board", value: "board", systemImage: "rectangle.split.2x1"),
        MonarchSegmentedItem("Grid", value: "grid", systemImage: "square.grid.2x2"),
    ],
    fillsWidth: false
)

examples.title: Filters with counts
examples.code:
MonarchSegmentedControl(
    "Tickets",
    selection: $filter,
    items: [
        MonarchSegmentedItem("Open", value: "open", count: "12"),
        MonarchSegmentedItem("Waiting", value: "waiting", count: "3"),
        MonarchSegmentedItem("Closed", value: "closed", count: "48"),
    ]
)
